how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-molten-core-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:7848:obj:0: Venture to the ⟦E1⟧ entry portal in ⟦E2⟧ and recover a ⟦E3⟧. Return to ⟦E4⟧ in ⟦E5⟧ when you have recovered the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:7848:details:0: Rifts stir, tear, and collapse all around us, ⟦1⟧. Not two paces from where I stand is a tear leading through the depths of ⟦E5⟧, into the maw of the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:7848:details:1: Surprised? Pity... The mortal races cannot comprehend that which they cannot see, touch, or feel.
rows.quest:7848:details:2: I assure you, the portal is there and access is possible.
rows.quest:7848:details:3: I've piqued your interest? Attunement is simple. Venture into ⟦E2⟧ and retrieve a core fragment. Return it to me and I shall attune your essence with the portal.
rows.quest:7848:progress:0: You must attune your soul with the ⟦E1⟧ before access is granted.
rows.quest:7848:completion:0: I am now able to transport you to the ⟦E1⟧. Ask and it shall be done.
rows.quest:8578:obj:0: Find ⟦E7⟧ and return them to ⟦E8⟧ in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:8578:details:0: <You hear a sigh of relief escape the crate.>
rows.quest:8578:details:1: You just want his scrying goggles? Great! That will be no problem... Just give me a minute to... Hey! Where the... Dagnabbit!
rows.quest:8578:details:2: Well, there's some bad news and some worse news. The bad news is that I lost the goggles. The worse news is that I lost them when I was nosing around in the ⟦E1⟧ last month. Yep, the ⟦E1⟧... I guess that concludes our business! Bye!
rows.quest:8578:progress:0: ⟦E10⟧, eh? I hope my goggles are still in one piece!
rows.quest:8578:completion:0: Outstanding! Now where did I put that 500 pound chicken and Volume II of "Draconic For Dummies???" Oh, and here's a little something for all your hard work!
